Deterministic rollback tests via SQLite fault-injection trigger avoid flaky concurrency races; always remove the injected fault in a finally block.

root_cause: The match handler performed two sequential unguarded writes (await payout.save(); await deposit.save()) with no transaction, and the unmatch handler did the same in reverse; the already-matched / not-matched-to-each-other guards were check-then-write with no row locks, so a concurrent match could race them. A failure between the two saves produced a half-written match that the API itself could not repair (409 guard).

summary: Implemented the top S1 finding BUG-001: POST and DELETE /v3/financials/matches in src/routes/monthlyclose.js now execute inside sequelize transactions with UPDATE row locks on both rows, so the two link writes commit together or roll back together. Expected 404/409 rejections are thrown as Error+statusCode inside the transaction and translated to HTTP responses after it; auditService.emitAudit fires only after successful commit; response JSON shapes are unchanged. This closes the API-unrepairable half-written match (old code saved payout then deposit separately; a crash between the saves left one side linked and the unmatch handler's mutual-link guard returned 409, blocking repair). Partial unique indexes were deliberately deferred to a separate migration task for existing-database compatibility.
